rows.canonical: GEMVKernelSet (P=1 GEMV kernel selector and receipt)
rows.definition: internal/metalgemm/gemv_kernel.go: the bit set naming which single-token (P=1) Metal GEMV kernels a dispatch or ProjectionGraph executed - GEMVKernelScalar (legacy q4k_gemv/q6k_gemv, one lane per 256-weight super-block), GEMVKernelVectorized (the opt-in float4 unpack), GEMVKernelMulMv (the llama.cpp-shaped q4k_mul_mv/q6k_mul_mv default) or GEMVKernelNone. GEMVKernel is the process default selected once from FAK_Q4K_GEMV_KERNEL (legacy restores the scalar parity reference); GraphReceipt.Q4KGEMVKernels/Q6KGEMVKernels report the executed set.
rows.distinction: It selects and records the P=1 projection KERNEL for Q4_K/Q6_K weights only - NOT q8DecodeKernel (the Q8 whole-token decode witness), NOT glmDsaMatKernel (the GLM-DSA compute selector) and NOT KernelCheck (the dispatchtick preflight).

rows.canonical: FullAttentionDevice (graph attention over a persistent device KV)
rows.definition: internal/metalgemm/graph.go: the ProjectionGraph full-attention op whose KV prefix lives in a caller-owned DeviceKV that persists across graphs; it applies optional QK-norm and rotate-half RoPE, appends the panel's K/V rows on the device, and attends (gated, or ungated when gate is nil). The dense whole-token Q4_K decode and the Qwen3.5 hybrid route use it so no host prefix is uploaded per token.
rows.distinction: It is the DEVICE-KV graph attention op - NOT qwen35FullAttentionHAL (the resident Qwen3.5 full-attention HAL step) and NOT FullAttentionInterval (which hybrid layers are full attention).

rows.definition: internal/model Config predicate reporting that the checkpoint declares the QSA sparse-attention layout; routes that only reproduce dense full attention (for example the dense whole-token Q4_K decode admission) decline when it is true.
rows.distinction: It is the QSA layout predicate - NOT isMiniMaxSparseAttn (the MiniMax sparse path) and NOT cudaDsaSparseAttnCosineMin (the CUDA GLM-DSA accuracy gate).

rows.definition: internal/model/moe.go predicate: the model's dense MLP is a SiLU-gated (SwiGLU) block, down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)); fused Metal MLP paths and the dense whole-token Q4_K decode admission require it.
rows.distinction: It is the FFN-activation predicate - NOT mlp.gate_proj (the gate projection weight), NOT gate_up_proj (the fused gate+up weight) and NOT a guard/egress gate such as StrictGatedSinks.
